title.value: Differentiable Causal Discovery from Interventional Data
title.justification: The title directly reflects the paper's focus on causal discovery using interventional data through differentiable methods, as explained in the abstract and introduction.
title.quote: Learning a causal directed acyclic graph from data is a challenging task that involves solving a combinatorial problem for which the solution is not always identifiable. This work constitutes a new step in this direction by proposing a theoretically-grounded method based on neural networks that can leverage interventional data.

analysis.description: This paper introduces a method called Differentiable Causal Discovery with Interventions (DCDI) for learning causal structures from data using neural networks capable of leveraging interventional data. The method extends continuous constrained optimization approaches to include interventional data, offering a theoretically grounded framework. It adapts normalizing flows for expressive density estimation, demonstrating competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods across various experimental settings.

type.justification: The paper primarily focuses on advancing the theoretical framework for causal discovery using differentiable methods and does not primarily present empirical results or experiments.
type.quote: We propose a theoretically-grounded differentiable approach to causal discovery that can make use of interventional data.

name.justification: The paper aims to advance causal discovery techniques, specifically through a differentiable approach using interventional data, fitting within the causal discovery field.
name.quote: In this work, we address the problem of data-driven causal discovery.

name.justification: The paper employs neural networks and continuous optimization techniques, common tools within the broader machine learning domain.
name.quote: We illustrate the flexibility of the continuous-constrained framework by taking advantage of expressive neural architectures such as normalizing flows.

name.justification: The paper uses neural networks to model conditional densities and learn causal structures, highlighting their role in the proposed method.
name.quote: The model we consider uses neural networks to model conditional densities.
